\section{Requirement to implementation, tests and demo}
Every MVP requirement of the brief maps to the code that implements it, its owner, the documented
test cases of Chapter~\ref{ch:testing} (each backed by automated tests) and the place it is shown
in the video. WF1--WF3 are the three demonstrated workflows.

\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{3.1cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{5.1cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{1.3cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{2.6cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{2.6cm}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Brief requirement} & \textbf{Implementation} & \textbf{Owner} & \textbf{Test cases} &
  \textbf{Demo} \\
\midrule
\endhead
Three user roles & \code{User} hierarchy (5 roles), role $\rightarrow$ permission map,
  register, password and Google sign-in, admin user screens & M1, M3 & TC-07, TC-15, TC-16 &
  M3 segment \\
Incident create to close & \code{Incident} aggregate, 10 State classes, 20 transitions,
  \code{IncidentService} facade & M1 & TC-01, TC-02, TC-08, TC-10 & WF1, WF2 \\
Classification, new categories without code & Categories as data; AI suggestion with
  confidence, overridable; keyword-rule fallback & M1, M2 & TC-01, TC-13 & WF1, M3 segment \\
Impact, urgency, business criticality & Weighted-product and matrix priority strategies,
  category floors, audited override & M1 & TC-01, TC-18 & WF1 \\
At least two assignment strategies & Skill-based, load-based and Smart (weighted, with
  reasons), switchable at runtime; 10-point capacity cap & M2 & TC-06, TC-11 & WF1, M3
  segment \\
SLA calculation, tracking, violations & Policy book per tier and priority, \code{SLAClock}
  with pause and stop, monitor every 30 s, violation records & M1, M2 & TC-04, TC-05, TC-19,
  TC-22 & WF2 \\
At least two notification mechanisms & In-app with live WebSocket push, email (console
  fallback), Telegram for urgent events & M1 & TC-14 & WF1, WF2 \\
Audit, complete history & Hash-chained audit log written in the change's transaction;
  integrity check & M3 & TC-02, TC-21 & every workflow \\
At least five search criteria & Nine filters plus free text, paging, CSV export & M3 &
  TC-03, TC-09 & M3 segment \\
At least two intelligent features & AI classification, duplicate detection, correlation and
  root-cause hint, smart assignment, predictive SLA risk, suggested resolution, automatic
  escalation & M2 & TC-13, TC-19, TC-20, TC-23 & WF1, WF3 \\
Persistence & Repositories over SQLite and PostgreSQL, 18 tables, migrations & M3 & TC-12,
  TC-14 & M3 segment \\
Exception handling & \code{ITSMError} hierarchy, one HTTP code per group, no stack traces &
  M1, M3 & TC-09 to TC-14 & WF2 (illegal transition) \\
Security & Argon2, JWT, lockout, role and ownership checks, validation, CORS & M3 & TC-07,
  TC-15 to TC-17 & M3 segment \\
At least two design patterns & Nine patterns (Chapter~\ref{ch:oop}) & All & covered by the
  suites above & M1 segment \\
\bottomrule
